name: clean-umami
description: Umami, a maintained Next.js/TypeScript web analytics app, used to measure false positives on clean code.

decoys.note: $queryRawUnsafe is called with bound parameters: {{name}} placeholders are rewritten to $n and values passed separately; search_path comes from the operator's DATABASE_URL.
orderBy is interpolated into SQL, but every route that reaches pagedRawQuery uses a Zod schema without sortingParams, so orderBy is stripped; page and size are coerced to numbers.
